name: price-target-fan
title: Price Target Fan
description: Recent price history followed by a cone from the low to the high target, with the average as a dashed line and the move against today's price.

props.name: history
props.description: Recent closes, oldest first; the last one is the current price.

props.name: targets
props.type: { low: number; avg: number; high: number }
props.description: The target range the fan opens to.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats prices in labels and the text summary (USD by default).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the text summary starts with it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
